features.name: Spellslinger at Arms
features.body: Gain Proficiencies in a single weapon type, all weapon foci, and Light armour.

features.name: Alternate Casting
features.body: Spells that require a Half Action to cast may be cast using an Extra Action. Spells that require an Extra Action may be cast using a Half Action.

features.name: Arcane Surge
features.body: The first time each round you cast **3 spells** in one turn, gain **+2 Mana**. Mana gained this way increases **+1** at Player Levels 4, 8, 12, 16, and 20.

features.name: Alacrity Points & Abilities
features.body: You gain max Alacrity Points equal to your **twice** your *Spellslinger Level*. Regain all Alacrity points upon a Short or Long Rest. At the start of Combat, gain **+2 Alacrity Points** (cannot surpass your max). This amount increases by **+1** at *Player Levels* 4, 9, 13, and 18. Alacrity Points can be used on the following abilities, more unlock as you gain levels in Spellslinger.

features.name: Spell Cascade
features.body:
Keep track of the last 5 spells you’ve cast. Whenever you cast a spell, if you’ve already cast a spell this combat and that spell is different from the last 5 spells you’ve cast, gain 1 stack of Cascade, up to a maximum of 5. When you repeat a spell within the last 5, remove all stacks of Cascade after the spell is cast, then reset the spells you were keeping track of.

For each stack of Cascade, gain +1 to Spell Attack rolls. For every 2 stacks of Cascade, gain +1 to your Spell Save DC. During your turn you may consume 2 stacks of Cascade to cast a Half Action spell as a Free Action, or consume 4 stacks to cast a Full Action spell as a Free Action.

abilities.name: Quickened Spell
abilities.body: Spend *1 Alacrity Point* to cast a **Full Action** spell as as a **Half Action**. This spell **loses Stat bonuses** to *Attack Rolls*, *Damage Rolls* and your Stat bonus to *Spell Save DCs*. Quickened spells also have a *-4m* range reduction if its base range is 10m or greater, or a *-2m* reduction if its base range is less than 10m. At Spellslinger Level 6, you no longer lose and Stat bonuses. At Spellslinger Level 9 you no longer lose range.

abilities.name: Instant Spell
abilities.body: Spend *1 Alacrity Point* to cast a **Half or Extra Action** spell as a **Free Action**. This can only be done *once per turn*. You can use this ability on spells which already had their Action cost reduced by Spellslinger or other sources.

abilities.name: Reactive Spell
abilities.body: As a Reaction you can spend Alacrity Points to cast a spell in response being attacked or targeted by an enemy Spell or ability. Spend *2 Alacrity Points* to cast a Full Action spell, or *1 Alacrity Point* to cast a Half or Extra Action spell.

abilities.name: cheaper spell
abilities.body: You can spend *2 Alacrity Points* to **reduce** the Mana cost of a spell by **-4** (cannot go below 0).

abilities.name: charge reduction
abilities.body: After a spell is cast if Charges were consumed for the spell or during its effect, you may spend *3 Alacrity Points* to refund those Charges.

drafts.body: Successfully landing a *0-mana* cost spell grants **+2 Mana**. You can only gain a *maximum* of **4 Mana** each turn this way. This Maximum increases by **+2** at *Player Levels* 8 and 16.

drafts.name: Spell Crescendo
drafts.body: casting spells or different spells helps with casting other spells
